answer: Yes, we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live elsewhere, so bring your Virginia registration. At a North Carolina store, a car registered in another state also needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it. Normally an expired registration doesn't stop a sale, but in North Carolina the registration must be current on the day of the sale, so plan to renew it before your appointment. The help center doesn't say how to renew a Virginia registration from North Carolina, or exactly how this rule applies to an out-of-state registration, so please check with your store.
